document.title: Original Issue Discount
document.issued_by: issuer or broker holding an OID obligation

boxes.label: Original issue discount for the year
boxes.notes: The form's own face carries the footnote '* This may not be the correct figure to report on your income tax return. See instructions on the back.' 'Report the amount in box 1 as interest income on your income tax return.'

boxes.label: Other periodic interest
boxes.notes: Qualified stated interest, separate from the OID. Its character depends on its neighbours: with an amount in box 8 it is U.S. Treasury interest (federally taxable, state-exempt); with an amount in box 11 it is TAX-EXEMPT interest and is not included in interest income. Box 9 is inside this figure.

boxes.label: Early withdrawal penalty
boxes.notes: An ADJUSTMENT to income. Note the box number: the early withdrawal penalty is box 2 on Form 1099-INT and box 3 here.

boxes.label: Market discount
boxes.notes: Reported only where the section 1278(b) election was made. CROSS-SCOPE NOTE: market discount NOT currently included in income is the origin of the Form 8949 column (f) code D adjustment on the later disposition; that route belongs to the capital gains scope.

boxes.label: Acquisition premium
boxes.notes: REDUCES BOX 1 (or box 8, or the tax-exempt OID in box 11). Enters Schedule B as a subtraction labelled 'OID Adjustment'. Where the payer reported a net amount of OID in box 1 or box 8, 'you must not make an adjustment to this amount for acquisition premium on Schedule B (Form 1040)'.

boxes.label: Description
boxes.notes: CUSIP or description of the obligation. No route.

boxes.label: Original issue discount on U.S. Treasury obligations
boxes.notes: 'Report this amount as interest income on your federal income tax return... This OID is exempt from state and local income taxes and is not included in box 1.' A negative figure is a deflation adjustment.

boxes.label: Investment expenses
boxes.notes: COMPONENT OF BOX 2 - note, box 2, not box 1. 'Any amount shown is your share of investment expenses of a single-class REMIC. This amount is included in box 2. Note: This amount is not deductible.' It routes nowhere.

boxes.label: Bond premium
boxes.notes: REDUCES BOX 2 (or, with an amount in box 11, reduces tax-exempt interest). Same 'ABP Adjustment' mechanism as Form 1099-INT box 11.

boxes.label: Tax-exempt OID
boxes.notes: Tax-exempt original issue discount on a covered tax-exempt obligation acquired on or after January 1, 2017.

boxes.label: CORRECTED (if checked)
boxes.notes: FR-016 mark. Printed above the issuer's block on every copy. A corrected form replaces one furnished earlier; its figures are the ones to use, never counted beside the earlier form's.

boxes.label: VOID
boxes.notes: FR-016 mark. Printed on Copy A (the issuer's filing copy) and the state copy; the recipient's Copy B does not print it.

boxes.label: Account number (see instructions)
boxes.notes: FR-016 mark. An account or other unique number the issuer assigned; identification only, never a figure.

boxes.label: FATCA filing requirement
boxes.notes: FR-016 mark. The issuer reports this account under chapter 4; the recipient may also have to file Form 8938. Moves no figure.

document.notes: Continuous-use form; revision in force for TY2024 and TY2025 is Rev. January 2024. Forms 1099-INT and 1099-OID share one set of filer instructions (i1099int). Box numbering differs between the two forms in a way that invites error: early withdrawal penalty is INT box 2 but OID box 3; investment expenses sit inside INT box 1 but inside OID box 2.

extraction.note: The note that stood here — "Azure ships no prebuilt-tax model for this form" — was STALE, and re-verified as stale twice (2026-09-24 and 2026-09-29) against Azure-Samples `schema/2024-11-30-ga/us-tax/`. v4.0 (2024-11-30 GA) publishes this model. No `fields` map is needed: every box this document declares is answered by Azure as `Box<n>`, which `normalize_box_name` already turns into the declared id.
